question: What result follows when the mantra is perfected through one hundred thousand repetitions?
premises: The mantra becomes perfected through one hundred thousand repetitions.
A desired object is sought by the practitioner.
The text asserts the result occurs with certainty.
inference: Once perfected by one hundred thousand repetitions, the mantra certainly accomplishes the desired object.
plain_english: When the mantra is perfected by one hundred thousand repetitions, the desired aim is certainly accomplished.
